response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(*) as client_count FROM disp JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), with_totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () as overall_total FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, client_count * 1.0 / region_total as share_of_region, client_count * 1.0 / overall_total as share_of_overall FROM with_totals ORDER BY share_of_overall DESC LIMIT 10
